facts.fact: 琼的梦里，西德妮的影像一闪换成阿比盖尔，这一次两个都没有消失。
facts.anchor: Sydney flickered, giving way to Abigail again. Only, this time, neither disappeared.

facts.fact: 琼意识到梦同时给出两张脸，是因为两张都不是真的。
facts.anchor: It was showing her both, she realized, because neither was real.

facts.fact: 琼脱掉借来的身体，侧腹旧伤钝痛，幻象随之裂开，露出外面的世界。
facts.anchor: The moment she was back in her own body, pain bloomed dully in her side, the ache of still-healing skin, and the illusion splintered, giving way to glimpses of the world beyond.

facts.fact: 裂开的幻象之外传来西德妮的声音，说她想醒来。
米奇把手按在胸口，抬起来时手指是红的。
米奇还没死、正在死，所以西德妮的能力修不了他，只能压住胸口止血。
facts.anchor: because Mitchell Turner wasn’t dead—he was still dying

facts.fact: 西德妮冲塞雷娜喊，说米奇在她需要时在场、救过她，因此不肯把他丢下。
facts.anchor: He was there when you weren’t. He saved me when you didn’t.

facts.fact: 米奇的手指在冰上想指向某处，西德妮回头看见琼穿过湖面、分开雾走来。
facts.anchor: a figure walking toward them, across the lake, parting the fog
